title: catalog.catalog-version-published.v1
description: A catalogue version became the active configuration, superseding whatever was published before it. Two kinds of consumer act on it: a cache of the catalogue, whose entries are keyed by version identifier and become unreachable rather than wrong; and anything that shows what is orderable, which re-reads through Catalog.Contracts.ICatalogAvailabilityQuery. It changes nothing already under way — a garment job pins its catalogue version at confirmation, so publishing never re-prices, re-routes or re-measures work in progress (docs/prd/category-hierarchy.md section 7). A consumer that treats this as 're-evaluate the open orders' has misread it.
$comment: additionalProperties is true on purpose. conventions.md section 5.5 permits additive changes within a major version, so a subscriber must tolerate a field it has not seen; a closed schema would make every such addition breaking. required lists the fields present when v1 was published — a field added within v1 is optional forever, because a dead-lettered message replayed later carries the payload as it was written.

eventId.description: Identity of this occurrence. Delivery is at least once; consumers de-duplicate on it.

occurredAt.description: When the version was published, in UTC.

aggregateId.description: The catalogue version that was published. It is what an order confirmed from now on is pinned to, and what a version-keyed cache is keyed by.

organisationId.description: The organisation whose catalogue it is. Exactly one version is published per organisation at any time.

versionNumber.description: The version's number, for a message a person reads. A label and never a key: every reference is by aggregateId (docs/architecture/conventions.md section 3.1).

supersededVersionId.description: The version that was current until now, retired by this publication, or null when this is the first version ever published. A consumer holding a cache keyed by that identifier may drop it, though it does not have to: the key is unreachable either way.

schemaVersion.description: The payload's major version. Agrees with the .v suffix of eventType.
